status: Version-specific material specular alpha / zero-power processing and rendering repaired. Original Wine acceptance remains incomplete.
changes: D3D7 CPU lighting selects specular alpha from material or COLOR1/COLOR2, honoring COLORVERTEX and missing-attribute fallback. Fog generation retains precedence. Shared lighting initialization explicitly defaults the profile off, preserving D3D8/9 input specular alpha and float precision.

D3D7 CPU ProcessVertices keeps the last successfully processed positive material power per device. SetMaterial alone and state-block recording do not advance it. Zero uses that history, initially disabling specular RGB before any positive-power processing. Public material and rendered GPU material power remain actual values.
Pre-D3D7 zero material power disables specular RGB in both CPU lighting preparation and GPU material submission, retaining the public material, alpha, render-state value and prelit colours.

Updated the retained D3D8/9 bound-draw harness to extract the existing shader-mode validator and use actual fixture shader objects; the previous harness omitted that production dependency and used sentinel pointers. Updated the existing typed-colour mutation anchor to preserve its source-alpha-loss fault. No D3D8/9 production shader validation or original Wine assertions changed.
